question: What share of the 0.1C reversible capacity is retained at 1C?
expect: 370 of ~700 mAh/gS: over 50% (the paper's words), ~53% computed (p5.L86-88)
trap: a share of the theoretical capacity
rendered: According to the text, at 0.1C, a decay to ∼60% capacity retention in the first 20 cycles is followed by stable behavior (∼0.1% decay per cycle) for 230 subsequent cycles. The capacity at 1C is 306 mAh/gS, which is ∼60% of the 0.1C capacity of ∼700 mAh/gS.
